function_coverage.assumptions_and_limits: Yaw-only LiDAR orientation; horizontal distance rho*cos(elevation), finite positive range strictly below .995*far is a measured hit. No surface extent or beam footprint reconstruction.

risks.claim: Belief ellipse exclusion can erase measured foreground first hits, including at zero covariance.
risks.counterexample: Sigma=0,rT=.15 gives sqrt(9.21)*rT=.45522m deletion radius; hit5.8m against belief6m is deleted. Cov=.01 deletes .53m foreground; large covariance, false association and mismatched camera depth are also reproduced.
risks.independent_test: ExclusionCounterexamples six role cases, valid mask/order/no mutation; closed-form scalar Mahalanobis checks
risks.baseline: Six valid role hits erased, including actual target; failures recorded before editing source.
risks.fix: ABSTAIN from identity and retain all valid first hits; API retained.
risks.remaining: Actual target also retained. Correct identity-aware exclusion is NOT_IMPLEMENTED; self-blocking and recall/efficiency cost remain.

risks.claim: Raw slant scan ranges were compared to horizontal world-XY query distance.
risks.counterexample: 20deg slant5m -> horizontal4.698463103929543m; old radius5m falsely admits q=4.85m. Projecting only the selected row minimum is also wrong when 0deg4.9 competes with20deg5.
risks.baseline: Bound5m; explicit elevation API absent; original proof includes5 expected keyword TypeErrors.
risks.fix: Project every row, then row minimum and horizontal margin. Default declared4row contract; explicit elevations for nonstandard rows.
risks.remaining: Sparse finite beams and different hit heights do not make a physical free-space certificate (B03).

risks.claim: FOV used the camera offset but forecast/BPOD LOS began at body origin.
risks.counterexample: ego(0,0),camera(.1,0),target(4,2),obstacle(2,.6),rOcc=.35: body-line distance .3577708764 (clear), optical-line .3331111527 (blocked), target in FOV.
risks.independent_test: Scalar segment oracle plus forecast/BPOD, rotated90deg fixture and no-double-offset control
risks.fix: Use yaw-rotated optical origin for both LOS paths; original LiDAR context stays at original scan pose.
risks.remaining: No full SE(3), height-aware occlusion or silhouette certificate; declared camera calibration still needs runtime validation.

risks.claim: Interpolated sparse-ray sectors do not prove continuous physical free space.
risks.counterexample: A radius.2m obstacle at5m and bearing2.5deg misses neighboring0/5deg rays: nearest-ray distance5*sin(2.5deg)=.2180969368>.2. All-no-return scan can nevertheless label its centre free.
risks.baseline: Analytic unobserved obstacle and sector-free output can coexist.
risks.fix: No unsupported ray filling or physical-free claim; retained explicit model limitation.
risks.remaining: Requires separately authorized observation/coverage model; 2D extrusion also cannot certify altitude or UAV attitude/vertical clearance.

risks.claim: True target first hit can self-block forecast and stop free-space extent short of target belief.
risks.counterexample: Target centre6m, raw first hit5.8m, margin.1m -> original sector endpoint5.7m and visible target hypothesis beyond it. Even excluding a point would not create measured free space behind the hit.
risks.baseline: Blocked rather than identity-correct positive visibility.
risks.fix: Preserved fail-closed BLOCKED. A01 retains true target too; no target-like return is filled to far.
risks.remaining: No qualified positive target-retention/visibility mechanism; cannot interpret a clear no-return synthetic scene as general sensor visibility validation.

risks.claim: Nonfinite/negative/out-of-range context evidence can certify free space after clipping or incomplete finite checks.
risks.counterexample: An unqueried inf/negative/above-far sector or NaN yaw/z-only pose may still return true; nonpositive/nonfinite far can admit origin.
risks.independent_test: ContextInputCounterexamples: invalid radii/yaw/position/far, point and segment separately, second valid env control
risks.baseline: 22 failing subtest entries across2 methods in expanded isolated13d5 source check; initial pre-guard proof also retained in scratch.
risks.fix: Invalidate whole env context row; sanitize only local arithmetic and AND validity mask on every answer; no source data writes or inf clipping.
risks.remaining: Angle-grid shape/uniformity remains an asserted structural contract, not arbitrary malformed-input recovery.

baseline_proofs.count_note: Subtest entries are not independent test methods; new helper checks were added for final coverage.

assumption_limits: Static measured XY point map; yaw-only projection; no full 3D SE(3)/silhouette/camera-realism qualification.
Known-free is an interpolated 2D scan-sector model, not a physical free-space guarantee.
Forecast/BPOD size thresholds must be declared consistently: params.r_T/min_pixels versus cam.target_radius/min_pixels.
Projected-area gate and stress detector rates are uncalibrated online predictions; oracle label does not mean simulator GT.
Gaussian active-margin linearization, independent obstacle products and stress Bernoulli independence remain approximations.
Exact FOV boundary floating comparisons have no tolerance; tan(pi/4) can round inward. Interior/exterior helper fixture uses .01m margin; source threshold not loosened.
No function advances dt; consumes supplied horizon. Sensor latency, real compute deadline and GPU behavior NOT_TESTED.
preservation: No raw/checkpoint reads or writes in this unit; source production modules untouched. Whole-repository protected-path SHA checks belong to parent integration receipt.
